dna.prompt: karakter lelaki kantoran umur 25 dengan stelan formal
dna.name: Office Formal Man

equipment.body: formal office suit with white dress shirt, dark navy blazer, and red tie
equipment.legs: matching dark navy dress pants with black dress shoes

directions.up: Back-view sprite in top-down pixel art: short black side-parted hair visible above a neat navy blazer collar. The shoulders are squared and formal, with a clean back seam and subtle shading. Dark dress pants fall straight to black shoes, giving a tidy office silhouette.
directions.down: Front-view sprite in top-down pixel art: a fair-skinned young man with almond dark brown eyes, short side-parted black hair, and a calm neutral expression. He wears a white shirt, red tie, and navy blazer over matching slacks, with a black belt and polished shoes.
directions.left: Left-facing side profile sprite in top-down view: the short black hair is neatly combed with a visible part, and the fair face shows a clean jawline. The navy blazer hangs straight over a slim torso, with the red tie peeking at the collar and straight dress pants below.
directions.right: Right-facing side profile sprite in top-down view: the same tidy office look is shown with the right side of the short side-parted hair and fair cheek visible. The blazer, white shirt, and red tie remain crisp, while the slim legs end in black dress shoes.
